editorial.blurb: This Indonesian kitchen near Wrigley Field channels the rendang traditions of Padang through meticulously researched recipes and a chef who's genuinely excited to share the story behind every dish.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the chef about the history and inspiration behind the menu items—he loves engaging with diners, and you might even score a complimentary dessert like the durian crème brûlée if you connect over the food.
